import MumfordLib.AffineSimplexChains

/-!
# Maps of ordered vertex-list chains

A map of vertex sets induces a chain map by applying it to each vertex.
This map commutes with coning, which is the naturality step in the recursive
construction of barycentric subdivision.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {V W Z : Type} {n : ℕ}

/-- Apply a map to every vertex of an ordered simplex. -/
def vertexListMap (f : V → W) : vertexListSSet V ⟶ vertexListSSet W where
  app _ := ↾fun v => f ∘ v

/-- The chain map induced by a map of vertex sets. -/
def vertexListChainMap (f : V → W) :
    VertexListChainComplex V ⟶ VertexListChainComplex W :=
  SSet.chainComplexMap (vertexListMap f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem vertexListChain_map (f : V → W) (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    vertexListChain v ≫ (vertexListChainMap f).f n = vertexListChain (f ∘ v) :=
  SSet.ι_chainComplexMap_f _ _ _ _ _

/-- Applying a map to a cone maps its cone vertex as well. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem vertexListCone_map (f : V → W) (b : V) (n : ℕ) :
    vertexListCone b n ≫ (vertexListChainMap f).f (n + 1) =
      (vertexListChainMap f).f n ≫ vertexListCone (f b) n := by
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro v
  change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
  simp only [vertexListChain_cone_assoc, vertexListChain_map,
    vertexListChain_map_assoc, vertexListChain_cone]
  congr 1
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

@[simp]
theorem vertexListChainMap_id :
    vertexListChainMap (id : V → V) = 𝟙 (VertexListChainComplex V) := by
  ext n : 1
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro v
  change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
  simp

@[simp]
theorem vertexListChainMap_comp (f : V → W) (g : W → Z) :
    vertexListChainMap (g ∘ f) = vertexListChainMap f ≫ vertexListChainMap g := by
  ext n : 1
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro v
  change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, vertexListChain_map_assoc,
    vertexListChain_map]
  rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
